body:
Real investigation found zero existing networked-lobby infrastructure (STATE_LOBBY is a local offline menu). Real open design questions found and named rather than guessed at: does the lobby trigger a match; one global instance vs real multi-instance discovery (no multi-room concept exists in this single-ServerState server); portraits vs walking avatars. 3 real options scoped in docs/BP_SOCIAL_LOBBY_NORTHSTAR.md, registered as golden doc BP-SOCIAL-LOBBY-NORTH. Card stays open pending founder decision on which option.

⚓ ☃
title: BPMM-x-123: social lobby scoped (Principle 19), not built -- real options + open questions named
